import pytest
from src.utils.config import parse_config

def test_parse_config_defaults():
    assert parse_config({}) == {
        "debug": False,
        "page_size": 25,
        "features": [],
    }

def test_parse_config_debug():
    assert parse_config({"debug": True})["debug"] is True
    assert parse_config({"debug": 1})["debug"] is True
    assert parse_config({"debug": 0})["debug"] is False
    assert parse_config({"debug": "yes"})["debug"] is True

def test_parse_config_page_size():
    assert parse_config({"page_size": 50})["page_size"] == 50
    assert parse_config({"page_size": "10"})["page_size"] == 10
    
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="page_size must be between 1 and 100"):
        parse_config({"page_size": 0})
    
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="page_size must be between 1 and 100"):
        parse_config({"page_size": 101})

def test_parse_config_features():
    assert parse_config({"features": "auth"})["features"] == ["auth"]
    assert parse_config({"features": ["auth", "items"]})["features"] == ["auth", "items"]
    assert parse_config({"features": [1, 2]})["features"] == ["1", "2"]
    
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="features must be a string or list"):
        parse_config({"features": 123})

def test_parse_config_invalid_input():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="config must be a dictionary"):
        parse_config(None)
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="config must be a dictionary"):
        parse_config([])
